review: Work C: KSA replacement and residency frequency/ownership
versionVerification: Read installed KSA.dll VersionInfo live with PowerShell; identical to cached AssemblyInfo and prior verified reference.
queueConclusion: Terrain preparation and culling are recorded before terrain draw in the same acquired-frame graphics-capable command buffer. Separate compute-pool submission is not the terrain-preparation queue.
transferConclusion: Texture uploads use a dedicated transfer family only when available and batch images are not already graphics-owned; otherwise graphics queue. Completion gate includes graphics acquire when required.
limits: No demonstrated KSA current/incoming exact physical-generation publication contract.
No measured KSA terrain milliseconds or guarantee against transition spikes.
32/96 MB uploader values are batching/admission targets, not hard per-frame time bounds; a whole request/batch may overshoot.
FreeImagePool has no explicit idle byte/count cap in reviewed class; active published-image budget is not a verified total idle-pool bound.
PlanetMeshLibrary and FreeImagePool are newly fingerprinted cached decompilation files, not prior-manifest matches or freshly decompiled source.
